description: Check that a live MCP server over Streamable HTTP speaks the protocol, 2026-07-28 or earlier: handshake or server/discover, tools/list and its definitions, error codes, one tools/call, structuredContent against outputSchema, latency. Returns PASS/FIX/BLOCK with a 0-100 score, or INCONCLUSIVE (score null) when authorization is required. The verdict covers the PROTOCOL, never whether tools answer correctly: what_this_does_not_prove lists what was not measured. Called: only test_tool_name, or a tool annotated readOnlyHint: true. A refusal of invented arguments is not scored (tool_behaviour: refused_placeholder); pass test_tool_args to exercise the tool. Private addresses and stdio are out of reach: paste tools/list into mcp_server_health_check.

test_tool_args.description: Real arguments, sent to the tested server. Without them, required ones are invented.

test_tool_name.description: Tool to call. Default: a read-only one, preferring no required arg.

url.description: Public URL of the MCP endpoint (e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp). An origin alone (https://www.ia-qa.com) tries /mcp, then /.

name: mcp_server_evaluate
